title: Add 10 Long Vrat Kathas with Narration to Vrat Katha Section

requirements.summary: Add 10 complete, long-form Vrat Kathas in Hindi to the static data file under the vrat category
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly 10 Vrat Katha entries exist in the static data with category 'vrat'
Each katha includes: Ekadashi, Solah Somvar, Mangalwar, Sukrwar, Karva Chauth, Santoshi Mata, Pradosh, Navratri, Satyanarayan, Hartalika Teej
Each katha's Hindi text is long-form (400+ words of narrative)
Each katha has a title, deity, and category field populated

file_operations.description: Add 10 new Vrat Katha entries to the kathas array with category 'vrat'. Each entry must include: (1) Ekadashi Vrat Katha dedicated to Lord Vishnu, (2) Solah Somvar Vrat Katha dedicated to Lord Shiva, (3) Mangalwar (Mangalvar) Vrat Katha dedicated to Lord Hanuman, (4) Sukrwar (Shukravar) Vrat Katha dedicated to Goddess Santoshi Mata, (5) Karva Chauth Vrat Katha dedicated to Goddess Parvati, (6) Santoshi Mata Vrat Katha dedicated to Goddess Santoshi, (7) Pradosh Vrat Katha dedicated to Lord Shiva, (8) Navratri Vrat Katha dedicated to Goddess Durga, (9) Satyanarayan Vrat Katha dedicated to Lord Vishnu/Satyanarayan, (10) Hartalika Teej Vrat Katha dedicated to Goddess Parvati. Each katha must have a full Hindi narrative text (hindiText field) of at least 400-600 words describing the vrat story, significance, and observance method. Include appropriate title (in Hindi), deity name, englishText (can be a brief English summary), tags array with relevant keywords, and category set to KathaCategory.vrat. Assign sequential IDs starting from the next available ID after existing kathas. Do not modify or remove any existing Ramayan or Mahabharat katha entries.

requirements.summary: Ensure the Kathayen listing page correctly displays all 10 Vrat Kathas when the vrat category tab is selected
acceptanceCriteria: Vrat Katha tab/filter shows exactly 10 katha cards
Content renders from static fallback even if the backend returns no data
Each card shows the correct title, deity, and a Hindi text preview

file_operations.description: Update the category filter logic to ensure the 'vrat' tab displays all kathas with category KathaCategory.vrat from the static kathaData fallback. Verify that the filter buttons include a 'Vrat' option that correctly filters the katha list. Ensure the static data from kathaData.ts is used as the primary or fallback source when backend data is unavailable or empty for the vrat category. Confirm that the KathaCard components render correctly for all 10 vrat kathas, showing title, deity, and Hindi text preview. The static fallback must guarantee that the vrat section is never empty after REQ-1 is implemented.

requirements.summary: Add audio narration controls to the Katha detail page for Vrat Kathas using the existing useSpeechNarration hook
acceptanceCriteria: Play button starts reading the katha text aloud in Hindi
Pause button pauses mid-narration and Resume resumes from the same position
Narration controls are visible for all Vrat Kathas on the detail page
Active narration state (playing/paused) is reflected in button styling
Narration uses hi-IN voice preference via the useSpeechNarration hook

file_operations.description: Import and integrate the existing useSpeechNarration hook from frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts to add Play, Pause, Resume, and Stop narration controls for Vrat Kathas. Position the narration controls prominently near the top of the katha content section, above or beside the language toggle. Wire the Play button to call the hook's play function with the full Hindi text (katha.hindiText) and hi-IN voice preference. Wire Pause, Resume, and Stop buttons to the corresponding hook methods. Display the current narration state (isPlaying, isPaused) visually by updating button styles (e.g., highlighting the active button, disabling unavailable actions). Ensure controls are visible for all kathas but emphasize they work best for long-form vrat kathas. Verify the hook's usage instructions in the hook file before implementing. Do not reimplement Web Speech API logic; use only the provided hook.
